remarks:
Exquisite penthouse offering the pinnacle of elegant city living with your own private wrap-around terrace and one of the most beautiful views in the city. Step off the elevator directly into your 9th floor unit and experience private city living. Foyer has hand glazed tiles and there are hardwood floors throughout. The living room features a cove ceiling, decorative fireplace with stylish plaster surround, built-in bookshelves, a bank of new arched windows and French doors also leading out to the terrace with incredible southern facing views of the skyline and sunsets over the lake from multiple rooms. The primary bedroom has a walk-in closet and tastefully updated en-suite bath with skylight. The fully renovated kitchen features solid surface countertops along with maple cabinetry and a formal dining/ breakfast room with picture molding on the walls. There is also a generously sized 2nd bedroom. A den/study with built-in cherry shelves.
83 Bryant Street in Buffalo, NY was originally designed by Canadian architect B. Frank Kelly. Constructed in the late 1920s, the structure features classic Italian Renaissance Revival This unit comes with a large storage locker in the basement, private underground garage, and a shared rooftop patio with phenomenal views. Close to the Medical Campus and stroll to Elmwood Village shops and restaurants. Ready to move-in! Unit is also available for rent.
